verdict.rationale: Justworks is an HR/payroll SaaS that holds sensitive employee and company data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data can be excluded from AI model training. The axis therefore applies. None of the evidence (help articles on payroll, benefits, time off, onboarding and the Xero integration, plus 404 probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI) mentions AI training, data-use opt-outs, or an AI privacy policy.
